dena (ML Eng): Quick heads-up — I spun up q4.1-small (4-bit) in the lab and ran the nightly bench against our promptset. Seeing a regression on hallucination score vs baseline. Not massive but consistent across domains.
liam (Applied ML): Can you paste the run id / diff?
dena (ML Eng): eval run id: run_2026_1923456789. eval-bot posted summary below — main delta is PMI_Hallucination +0.14 and QA_exact_match -2.3%.
eval-bot: Automated eval complete for run_2026_1923456789. Comparing q4.1-small -> baseline. Metrics: 
- PMI_Hallucination: 0.38 -> 0.52 (+0.14)
- QA_exact_match: 78.1 -> 75.8 (-2.3)
- Latency p50: 120ms -> 85ms (expected)
Full diff available: https://internal-evals/runs/run_2026_1923456789
sophie (Labeling Lead): Ugh. Could be dataset curation noise — did we dedupe properly between training-sample-like prompts and golden? We had that partial dedup last week.
dena (ML Eng): Good point. I noticed a cluster of paraphrase duplicates in the open web cohort; some are near-identical to training seeds.
aria (Annotator): I can re-run a quick dedupe pass with the new fingerprinting. Suggest fingerprints: sha1(text + normalized_whitespace + sorted_tokens). Want me to flag candidates for golden replacement?
sophie (Labeling Lead): Yes please. Also add a length stratification check — we saw more failures on long-context QA. Add bins: short (<50), med (50-200), long (>200).
liam (Applied ML): Agreed. Also let's isolate whether quantization changed decoding behaviour on rare tokens. Can we push a focused eval: same promptset but only golden curated examples and another run with the deduped set removed? That'll tell us data vs model.
matt (Infra): I can spin the focused eval. Command I'll run: ```bash
python infra/run_eval.py --model q4.1-small --prompts-file s3://redwood-eval/promptsets/golden_v2.json --out run_2026_1923456789_focus.json
```
I'll shard across 8 workers; expect results in ~12m.
sophie (Labeling Lead): Quick note on golden: last golden refresh (golden_v2) included 1200 items, 80 labeled anchors. Before we commit changes, let's ensure we don't accidentally remove anchors that are used in regression monitors. Could aria produce a mapping file of anchor ids -> new_fingerprint?
aria (Annotator): On it. I'll run dedupe with thresholds: jaccard_token >= 0.85 or levenshtein_norm <= 0.1 -> immediate candidate. Will output CSV: `anchor_id,old_text,new_fp,dup_score,action_recommendation`.
dena (ML Eng): Perfect. After aria's pass, liam/matt please run two evals: (A) current golden_v2 only, (B) golden_v2 with deduped candidates excluded. We'll compare both against baseline. If (B) recovers, it's curation noise. If neither recovers, likely quantization/regression.
liam (Applied ML): Adding to that — run a small calibrated decode test varying temperature and topk for q4.1-small vs baseline to see sensitivity. I'll try temp=0.0, 0.2, 0.7 and top_k=50 vs top_k=200.
eval-bot: Focused eval run started: run_2026_1923456789_focus (A) golden_v2 only. Shard 8/8. ETA 11m.
sophie (Labeling Lead): Also, remind we have a small holdout of adversarial anchors (adv_anchor_set) that historically surface hallucination regressions. Keep those in both runs — they are our early-warning.
dena (ML Eng): Good call. Make sure adv_anchor_set is included. If the regressions concentrate on adv anchors, that's informative.
aria (Annotator): Done with dedupe run: uploaded `dedupe_candidates_1923456789.csv` to s3://redwood-ops/labeling/dedupe/. 47 candidate anchors flagged. Sample of CSV: `#anchor_id,old_text,new_fp,dup_score,action_recommendation
A-1123,"When was the Eiffel Tower built?","fp_2b7f...",0.92,REPLACE
A-1131,"List steps to reset router","fp_9c1a...",0.88,REVIEW`
sophie (Labeling Lead): I'll review 10 highest-dup ones now and sign off on replacements. Planning a short labeling pass tomorrow morning to relabel 50 items (mix of anchors + edge cases).
matt (Infra): Focused eval (A) completed: run_2026_1923456789_focus_A. Results pushed. Summary: slight improvement on some anchors, overall PMI_Hallucination still +0.12 vs baseline. Starting (B) with deduped removed.
liam (Applied ML): If (B) still shows reg, we'll run a quantization ablation: q4.1-small w/ different rounding modes + per-channel vs per-tensor. I have scripts to produce calibration curves.
dena (ML Eng): Thanks everyone. Action items: aria -> finalize dedupe CSV (done), sophie -> approve replacements and schedule relabeling, matt -> run eval (B) and forward results, liam -> prep quant ablations if needed. I'll monitor and update the incident board. :eyes:
sophie (Labeling Lead): ACK. Will post labeler ETA in #labeling in 15m. :thumbsup:
liam (Applied ML): I'll also run a small manual pass on 20 failing examples to see if hallucinations are content-specific. Will post notes.
dena (ML Eng): Good. If anyone finds an obvious single-prompt failure mode, drop it here and we'll pin to the model regression ticket. Thanks all! :sparkles:
